items.title: Sadie Goodson Interview, 1984-12-12
items.q: Who were you with? Pop Silverstein.

ctx.x: Not at the time when I was there. I don't know what they do now.

They may be doing it now, but they didn't. They sound like he was on the new, were you saying that? Yeah. Well anyway, that's enough of that old music stuff, until we get between the reels. Then we'll play a little four handed. Can you play bass while I play treble? Mm-hmm. Okay. Play bass while you play treble. Yeah. Go ahead, Joel. All right. Now you came here, you said in 1920. Uh-huh. What was the first place you played when you came to New Orleans? When I first came to New Orleans, I played at the Pelican.…

That's the first job? Did you know him from Pensacola? No, I met him through in Chinese, because Chinese played drums with him. And Chinese was my husband at that time. So he had sent for Jeanette the cup. So I was on the boat playing then. Already when you first got here you were?
